notes: Failed refine (AUROC 0.797, median fire 0.29, 3/8 fire >= 0.30, 1 near miss >= 0.30). Direction holds: 7/8 near misses stayed <= 0.22, and science/research prose (physics, astronomy, biology, history of science, court text) all reach 0.3-0.76 in my pre-draw probes, so the earlier 'physical things only' label was too narrow. But fire items are weak and scatter over arbitrary tokens (why, helium, everything, ., debris, or), and a recipe near miss peaked on 'stir' (0.435). Single sentences are too short to show it: a clearly on-topic one-liner scored 0.04 alone. Loop-back: neighbours L9/N926+ and L27/N2326- failed (L27 is dense/weak), L7/N3945+ held; none sharpens this pole. Treat as a weak diffuse pole (9.5% of tokens at 0.1 of max, prediction-type): label as diffuse science-news prose, not a sharp concept.
label: Ordinary mid-sentence words (to, with, for, more, the) inside running science and research explainer prose (physics, devices, astronomy, biology, what causes what); weaker for economics and history, low for fiction, chat, recipes, politics news, code and maths.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

qc.label_under_test: Ordinary words in impersonal explanatory prose about how physical things work (gases, electricity, machines, devices, planets): what causes what, e.g. 'the more you press it, the faster it goes'; weaker for biology or economics, near zero for code, maths proofs and stories about people.
